description.zh: 参数值配置，生产环境必填。如果数组中出现了重复的环境配置，则后出现的配置不生效。
description.en: The parameter value configuration. This parameter is required for the production environment. If you specify the same environment multiple times, only the first configuration is used.

description.zh:

description.en:
The project environment.

- `Prod`: the production environment

- `Dev`: the development environment

descriptions.en: This operation is available only in DataWorks Professional Edition and later.
